sourceEvidence.title: Project Engineering Sr Mgr
sourceEvidence.quote: Standard Job Description Directs, coordinates, and exercises functional authority for planning, performance, and completion of program portfolio projects within the Manufacturing and Test environment. Manages the program execution and program performance of experimental engineering, development, and production lifecycle through the hardware assembly/integration/test processes. Collaborates with Operations, Program Management, Support Functions, and Customer Stakeholder teams to ensure program and project management success (Earned Value Management, Cost Account Management, Risk and Opportunity Management, etc). Leads, creates, and submits Proposal activities and Basis of Estimates on behalf of site Operations team. Provides inputs and deliverables as a qualified Operations liason supporting Finance, Program Office, and Contracts Office business rhythms. Coordinates subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions. Plans, formulates, and organizes project staff according to requirements. Assigns project personnel to specific phases or aspects of project. Coordinates activities concerned with technical development, scheduling, and resolution of engineering design, manufacture, and test executing in a shop floor setting. Basic Qualifications To be considered, candidates must meet all requirements listed: 5+ years of experience as a leader of teams in the Program Office and/or in Production Operations/Assembly, Integration, & Test (AI&T) 3+ years of experience supporting production lifecycle programs in a manufacturing/test "production at rate" environment Ability to demonstrate strong understanding of program performance metrics and business rhythms (Earned Value Management, Cost Account Management, Risk & Opportunity Management, etc) Experience leading individual contributors and leaders Experience providing proposal inputs and basis of estimates Desired Skills Nice-to-have skills that strengthen candidacy but are not required: Experience leading teams in Contracts/Subcontract Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Quality, Planning Ex
